Source
Expand description

Text and font support.

krilla has extensive support for OpenType fonts. It supports CFF-based as well as TTF-based OpenType fonts. In addition to that, krilla also supports all major tables used in color fonts, including the SVG, COLR, sbix and CBDT/EBDT (only PNG) tables, something that, to the best of my knowledge, no other Rust crates provides.

Even better is the fact that you do not need to take care of choosing the right table for drawing glyphs: All you need to do is to provide the Font object with an appropriate index.

Font
An OpenType font. Can be a TrueType, OpenType font or a TrueType collection. It holds a reference to the underlying data as well as some basic information about the font.

KrillaGlyph
